largest_vegas_favorite.note: Largest raw Vegas favorite this week (-625 ML, -11.5/-10 vs TEN, ~83% no-vig implied). Never the recommendation by policy. The Arbiter cut it to 0.76 (4-2 record running ahead of -2.0 yds/g efficiency, thin safeties, a letdown spot); it would still top NE's 0.69, so the policy is what moves the pick to NE. The largest favorite has gone 4-3 this season.

status_note: Eliminated from the main prize (2 mistakes: Week 2 TB, Week 7 NYJ). Playing for fewest mistakes, so no opportunity-cost logic: the recommendation is the highest Arbiter probability among non-excluded, unused teams.
process_note: Byes: HOU, NO, NYG, SF. Shortlist of 14 got the full Advocate/Skeptic/Arbiter debate, including used JAX, DET, TB, NYJ and KC. No trap flags: per L19, no favorite has its own starting QB out (the Arbiter's DAL/WAS suggestions are reflected as L18-capped probabilities instead). Lessons applied: L18 (DAL, WAS, NYJ capped as sub-.500 favorites with negative yards diff), L17 (Lamar graded as playing), L14 (CIN, LA, GB record-vs-efficiency haircuts), L8 (SEA without LT Cross). Weather: no reliable 2026 forecasts found at run time (Thursday).
